title: The Kurosagi Corpse Delivery Service
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Five students from a Buddhist university in Tokyo use odd skills (channeling, dowsing, embalming, hacking) to help the dead who remain trapped in their corpses, carrying bodies wherever they need to go so their souls can move on to rebirth. Kuro Kuratsu hears the voices of corpses; he works with hacker Ao Sasaki, dowser Makoto Numata, embalmer Keiko Makino and Yuji Yata, who channels an alien through a hand puppet. Episodic cases dramatize social phenomena around death (Dark Horse blurb; ANN review).
life_message: The dead deserve to be heard and laid to rest, and a society should face how it treats death.
